facts: The csproj sets no Nullable property (catalog-service.csproj:2-6).
The project uses the Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web SDK (catalog-service.csproj:1).
The active database is SQLite: App.UseSQLite is true in appsettings.json and Program.cs:21-23 registers FoodDBContext with UseSqlite.
The SQL Server branch in Program.cs:25-28 is inactive while UseSQLite is true.
SQLite connection string is Data Source=./food.db (appsettings.json, App.ConnectionStrings.SQLiteDBConnection).
Authentication is disabled: App.AuthEnabled is false in appsettings.json, so Program.cs:51 registers plain AddControllers without the auth filter.
FoodDBContext seeds five CatalogItem rows with IDs 1 to 5 via HasData (Infrastructure/FoodDBContext.cs:29-37).
CatalogItem.ID is int, Price is decimal, InStock is int (Domain/CatalogItem.cs:5-8).
Common/AppBuilder.cs AddConfig reads App:UseAppConfig, which is false in appsettings.json, so the Azure App Configuration provider is not loaded.
Common/AppBuilder.cs registers Swagger (AddEndpointsApiExplorer and AddSwaggerGen), Application Insights with AILogger, feature management, and an AllowAll CORS policy.

Program.cs calls AddConfig, AddApplicationInsights, AddFeatureManagement, AddEndpointsApiExplorer and AddNoCors, and calls UseAzureAppConfiguration, UseSwaggerUI and UseNoCors on the app (Program.cs:13-60).
test-controllers.http has requests for config and food reads, and a valid create and update body. It has no request for a 400 or 404 case (test-controllers.http:19-51).

create-food-client-supplied-id-conflict-.reason: Controllers/FoodController.cs:42 adds the client body without resetting ID. SQLite is active (Program.cs:21-23, appsettings.json UseSQLite true) and seeds IDs 1 to 5 (Infrastructure/FoodDBContext.cs:31-35), so a valid body with id 1 fails the primary key insert and returns 500. contract.md row POST /food valid expects 201, and its validity rule (contract.md:14) does not mention IDs.

update-food-delete-race-500.reason: Needs a concurrent delete between the existence check and SaveChangesAsync (Controllers/FoodController.cs:56-61 and 69-75). contract.md is silent on concurrency. Choosing 404 or 409 on DbUpdateConcurrencyException is a design decision.

valid-price-overflow-500.reason: Only reachable when UseSQLite is false, because the decimal(18,4) column type is set in Infrastructure/FoodDBContext.cs:26-27 and SQLite is active in Program.cs:21-23. contract.md does not define a maximum Price, so whether validation should cap it is open.

get-food-id-nonint-400.reason: Domain/CatalogItem.cs:5 types ID as int, so /food/abc is not a request for an ID. The 400 is the ASP.NET [ApiController] binding response. contract.md rows cover only IDs that exist or do not exist.

http-file-no-contract-cases.reason: The contract constrains controller behaviour, and contract.md does not mention test-controllers.http. The finding is a coverage gap in sample requests, not a contract violation.
